005package org.wpilib.smartdashboard;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
008import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
009import org.wpilib.util.Color8Bit;
010
011/**
012 * Ligament node on a Mechanism2d. A ligament can have its length changed (like an elevator) or
013 * angle changed, like an arm.
014 *
015 * @see Mechanism2d
016 */
017public class MechanismLigament2d extends MechanismObject2d {
018  private double m_angle;
019  private String m_color;
020  private double m_length;
021  private double m_weight;
022
023  /**
024   * Create a new ligament.
025   *
026   * @param name The ligament name.
027   * @param length The ligament length.
028   * @param angle The ligament angle in degrees.
029   * @param lineWidth The ligament's line width.
030   * @param color The ligament's color.
031   */
032  public MechanismLigament2d(
033      String name, double length, double angle, double lineWidth, Color8Bit color) {
034    super(name);
035    setColor(color);
036    setLength(length);
037    setAngle(angle);
038    setLineWeight(lineWidth);
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Create a new ligament with the default color (orange) and thickness (6).
043   *
044   * @param name The ligament's name.
045   * @param length The ligament's length.
046   * @param angle The ligament's angle relative to its parent in degrees.
047   */
048  public MechanismLigament2d(String name, double length, double angle) {
049    this(name, length, angle, 10, new Color8Bit(235, 137, 52));
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Set the ligament's angle relative to its parent.
054   *
055   * @param degrees the angle in degrees
056   */
057  public final synchronized void setAngle(double degrees) {
058    m_angle = degrees;
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Set the ligament's angle relative to its parent.
063   *
064   * @param angle the angle
065   */
066  public synchronized void setAngle(Rotation2d angle) {
067    setAngle(angle.getDegrees());
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Get the ligament's angle relative to its parent.
072   *
073   * @return the angle in degrees
074   */
075  public synchronized double getAngle() {
076    return m_angle;
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Set the ligament's length.
081   *
082   * @param length the line length
083   */
084  public final synchronized void setLength(double length) {
085    m_length = length;
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Get the ligament length.
090   *
091   * @return the line length
092   */
093  public synchronized double getLength() {
094    return m_length;
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Set the ligament color.
099   *
100   * @param color the color of the line
101   */
102  public final synchronized void setColor(Color8Bit color) {
103    m_color = String.format("#%02X%02X%02X", color.red, color.green, color.blue);
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Get the ligament color.
108   *
109   * @return the color of the line
110   */
111  public synchronized Color8Bit getColor() {
112    int r = 0;
113    int g = 0;
114    int b = 0;
115    if (m_color.length() == 7 && m_color.charAt(0) == '#') {
116      try {
117        r = Integer.parseInt(m_color.substring(1, 3), 16);
118        g = Integer.parseInt(m_color.substring(3, 5), 16);
119        b = Integer.parseInt(m_color.substring(5, 7), 16);
120      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
121        r = 0;
122        g = 0;
123        b = 0;
124      }
125    }
126    return new Color8Bit(r, g, b);
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Set the line thickness.
131   *
132   * @param weight the line thickness
133   */
134  public final synchronized void setLineWeight(double weight) {
135    m_weight = weight;
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Get the line thickness.
140   *
141   * @return the line thickness
142   */
143  public synchronized double getLineWeight() {
144    return m_weight;
145  }
146
147  @Override
148  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
149    double angle;
150    double length;
151    String color;
152    double weight;
153    synchronized (this) {
154      angle = m_angle;
155      length = m_length;
156      color = m_color;
157      weight = m_weight;
158    }
159
160    table.log("angle", angle);
161    table.log("length", length);
162    table.log("color", color);
163    table.log("weight", weight);
164    super.logTo(table);
165  }
166
167  @Override
168  public String getTelemetryType() {
169    return "line";
170  }
171}
